author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.7.2 — Adds a workStatusCode attribute exposing the raw numeric status code behind the status label. The status label mapping was sourced from a single third-party project, unverified against live 200S telemetry -- if a label ever looks wrong (e.g. Returning to charge while charging:true), this gives real numeric evidence to correct it with instead of guessing.
